provenance_mix.summary_label: Mixed: 4.6% Modeled / 95.4% Proxy — Partial coverage (1 component unavailable)

STATIONARY_ENERGY.methodology_note: Aggregated from 1/2 available subsectors in SEEG Coleção 14.0 (GWP-AR5).
STATIONARY_ENERGY.gap_note: Grid Electricity Consumption (Scope 2): Obtain annual municipality-wide electricity consumption (MWh) for Quatro Barras from Copel Distribuição / ANEEL SINDAT for a year with a verified MCTI SIN grid factor. | Stationary Fuel Combustion (Residential, Commercial, Industrial & Public): Obtain ANP municipal LPG (GLP) sales and local industrial boiler fuel logs in Quatro Barras.

subsectors.availability_reason: SEEG Municípios reports Scope 1 fuel combustion at power-generation plants; municipal Scope 2 purchased electricity consumption is not reported.
subsectors.data_source: Not reported in SEEG Municípios Coleção 14.0
subsectors.operational_coverage: Scope 2 purchased grid electricity (missing in SEEG)
subsectors.methodology_note: Explicitly marked UNAVAILABLE (null) rather than 0.0 tCO2e so unmeasured electricity consumption is never mistaken for zero emissions.
subsectors.limitations: Scope 2 electricity is excluded from the public SEEG municipal baseline.
subsectors.gap_note: Obtain annual municipality-wide electricity consumption (MWh) for Quatro Barras from Copel Distribuição / ANEEL SINDAT for a year with a verified MCTI SIN grid factor.

subsectors.subsector_name: Stationary Fuel Combustion (Residential, Commercial, Industrial & Public)
subsectors.operational_coverage: Scope 1 stationary fuel combustion (GLP, diesel, fuel oil)
subsectors.methodology_note: State-level ANP/EPE fuel balances disaggregated to municipalities via IBGE population and industrial/commercial value-added proxies.
subsectors.limitations: Top-down state disaggregation; does not reflect local industrial boiler audits.
subsectors.gap_note: Obtain ANP municipal LPG (GLP) sales and local industrial boiler fuel logs in Quatro Barras.

TRANSPORTATION.methodology_note: Aggregated from 2/2 available subsectors in SEEG Coleção 14.0 (GWP-AR5).
TRANSPORTATION.limitations: Subject to subsector top-down proxy or spatial modeling uncertainties.
TRANSPORTATION.gap_note: On-Road Transportation (Urban Fleet, Freight & Public Transit): Obtain municipality-wide ANP SIMP retail fuel sales (diesel, gasoline, ethanol) for Quatro Barras. | Aviation, Rail & Off-Road Transportation: Obtain local airport QAV fuel uplift records (if applicable) and off-road diesel logs for Quatro Barras.

subsectors.subsector_name: On-Road Transportation (Urban Fleet, Freight & Public Transit)
subsectors.data_source: SEEG Municípios Coleção 14.0 — Energia / Transportes / Rodoviário
subsectors.methodology_note: State/regional ANP fuel distribution allocated to municipalities using SENATRAN fleet shares and highway VKT modeling.
subsectors.limitations: Includes top-down highway fuel allocation proxies; retail pump sales may differ.
subsectors.gap_note: Obtain municipality-wide ANP SIMP retail fuel sales (diesel, gasoline, ethanol) for Quatro Barras.

subsectors.data_source: SEEG Municípios Coleção 14.0 — Energia / Transportes (Aéreo, Ferroviário)
subsectors.operational_coverage: Aviation LTO/uplift and rail/off-road mobile combustion
subsectors.methodology_note: Regional aviation kerosene (QAV) and rail/waterway diesel allocated by ANAC airport LTO cycles and transport network proxies.
subsectors.limitations: National/regional allocation proxy where local airport uplift logs are absent.
subsectors.gap_note: Obtain local airport QAV fuel uplift records (if applicable) and off-road diesel logs for Quatro Barras.

WASTE.methodology_note: Aggregated from 2/2 available subsectors in SEEG Coleção 14.0 (GWP-AR5).
WASTE.limitations: Subject to subsector top-down proxy or spatial modeling uncertainties.
WASTE.gap_note: Municipal Solid Waste Disposal & Incineration: Obtain certified municipal landfill weighbridge tonnage and biogas flaring logs for Quatro Barras. | Domestic & Industrial Wastewater Treatment: Obtain Sanepar / municipal ETE plant-level BOD inflow/outflow and biogas flaring logs for Quatro Barras.

subsectors.data_source: SEEG Municípios Coleção 14.0 — Resíduos (Disposição final, Incineração)
subsectors.operational_coverage: Solid waste landfill disposal, open burning, and biological treatment
subsectors.methodology_note: IPCC First-Order Decay (FOD) model driven by SNIS / IBGE per-capita waste generation and regional landfill/dumpsite shares.
subsectors.limitations: Relies on regional SNIS waste composition and landfill gas capture assumptions.
subsectors.gap_note: Obtain certified municipal landfill weighbridge tonnage and biogas flaring logs for Quatro Barras.

subsectors.methodology_note: Estimated from municipal population, SNIS sewage coverage rates, and industrial BOD proxies using IPCC CH4/N2O effluent emission factors.
subsectors.limitations: Uses regional BOD and treatment-type shares rather than ETE plant monitoring.
subsectors.gap_note: Obtain Sanepar / municipal ETE plant-level BOD inflow/outflow and biogas flaring logs for Quatro Barras.

IPPU.data_source: SEEG Municípios Coleção 14.0 (Industrial Processes and Product Use)
IPPU.operational_coverage: GPC Industrial Processes and Product Use sector
IPPU.methodology_note: Aggregated from 1/1 available subsectors in SEEG Coleção 14.0 (GWP-AR5).
IPPU.limitations: Subject to subsector top-down proxy or spatial modeling uncertainties.
IPPU.gap_note: Industrial Processes & Product Use (IPPU): Obtain municipal environmental licensing (IAT) industrial process inventory and HFC audit for Quatro Barras.

subsectors.availability_reason: Reported in SEEG Coleção 14.0 GWP-AR5 (2025) as 0.00 tCO2e.
subsectors.operational_coverage: Non-energy industrial processes and product use
subsectors.methodology_note: Point-source cement/lime/metallurgy allocation and national HFC/solvent proxies downscaled by municipal industrial registry.
subsectors.limitations: Commercial HFC refrigeration leakage is often not captured at municipal level (may read 0.0).
subsectors.gap_note: Obtain municipal environmental licensing (IAT) industrial process inventory and HFC audit for Quatro Barras.

AFOLU.sector_name: Agriculture, Forestry and Other Land Use
AFOLU.data_source: SEEG Municípios Coleção 14.0 (Agriculture, Forestry and Other Land Use)
AFOLU.operational_coverage: GPC Agriculture, Forestry and Other Land Use sector
AFOLU.methodology_note: Aggregated from 2/2 available subsectors in SEEG Coleção 14.0 (GWP-AR5).
AFOLU.limitations: Subject to subsector top-down proxy or spatial modeling uncertainties.
AFOLU.gap_note: Agriculture, Livestock & Managed Soils: Verify local cooperative fertilizer sales and manure management practices within Quatro Barras. | Land-Use Change & Forestry (Net Emissions/Removals): Integrate municipal CAR field-verified forest biomass and urban arborization inventory for Quatro Barras.

subsectors.operational_coverage: Enteric fermentation, manure management, and agricultural soils
subsectors.methodology_note: Modeled from IBGE Pesquisa da Pecuária Municipal (PPM) herd counts, PAM crop areas, and IPCC Tier 2 enteric fermentation & soil N2O factors.
subsectors.limitations: Census-based modeling; does not capture farm-level manure biodigesters or precision N practices.
subsectors.gap_note: Verify local cooperative fertilizer sales and manure management practices within Quatro Barras.

subsectors.data_source: SEEG Municípios Coleção 14.0 — Mudança de Uso da Terra e Floresta (MapBiomas)
subsectors.operational_coverage: Land-use transitions and forest carbon removals
subsectors.methodology_note: Spatially modeled at 30m resolution from MapBiomas annual land-cover transition matrices (gross deforestation/soil carbon emissions net of secondary forest removals).
subsectors.limitations: Satellite 30m pixel classification uncertainty and biome-average carbon stocks.
subsectors.gap_note: Integrate municipal CAR field-verified forest biomass and urban arborization inventory for Quatro Barras.

climate_risks.hazard_description: AdaptaBrasil MCTI municipal climate risk index for inundações, enxurradas e alagamentos in Quatro Barras (classification: Baixo, 0.23/1.00).
climate_risks.methodology_note: Composite IPCC climate risk index combining climate hazard, exposure, and socio-environmental vulnerability modeled at municipal scale by MCTI/INPE.
climate_risks.limitations: National modeled composite index; does not incorporate recent municipal drainage or civil defense logs.
climate_risks.gap_note: Integrate municipal Defesa Civil georeferenced flood/landslide occurrence logs and municipal stormwater drainage master plan (Plano Diretor de Drenagem) to provide local evidence.
